import re
xml=open('/tmp/xlsx_extract/xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml').read()
styles=open('/tmp/xlsx_extract/xl/styles.xml').read()
# parse numFmts
fmts={}
for f in re.findall(r'<numFmt numFmtId="(\d+)" formatCode="([^"]*)"/>', styles):
    fmts[int(f[0])]=f[1]
# parse fills
fills=re.findall(r'<fill>(.*?)</fill>', styles, re.S)
def fillinfo(i):
    f=fills[i]
    fg=re.search(r'<fgColor rgb="([^"]+)"', f)
    theme=re.search(r'<fgColor theme="(\d+)"', f)
    pat=re.search(r'patternType="([^"]+)"', f)
    return f'pat={pat.group(1) if pat else "?"} fg={fg.group(1) if fg else ""} theme={theme.group(1) if theme else ""}'
# parse fonts
fonts=re.findall(r'<font>(.*?)</font>', styles, re.S)
def fontinfo(i):
    f=fonts[i]
    name=re.search(r'<name val="([^"]+)"', f)
    sz=re.search(r'<sz val="([^"]+)"', f)
    b=re.search(r'<b val="1"', f) or re.search(r'<b/>', f)
    return f'{name.group(1) if name else "?"},{sz.group(1) if sz else "?"},{bool(b)}'
# parse cellXfs entries
m=re.search(r'<cellXfs count="44">(.*?)</cellXfs>', styles, re.S)
entries=re.findall(r'<xf (.*?)/>', m.group(1))
def styleinfo(s):
    e=entries[s]
    nf=re.search(r'numFmtId="(\d+)"', e)
    font=re.search(r'fontId="(\d+)"', e)
    fill=re.search(r'fillId="(\d+)"', e)
    border=re.search(r'borderId="(\d+)"', e)
    nfid=int(nf.group(1)) if nf else 0
    f=int(font.group(1)) if font else 0
    fi=int(fill.group(1)) if fill else 0
    b=int(border.group(1)) if border else 0
    nfmt=fmts.get(nfid,'General' if nfid==0 else f'id{nfid}')
    return f'nf={nfmt} font={fontinfo(f)} fill={fillinfo(fi)} border={b}'
# parse cells in sheet
for cm in re.finditer(r'<c r="([A-Z]+[0-9]+)"(?: s="(\d+)")?(?: t="([^"]+)")?', xml):
    coord, s, t = cm.groups()
    if s is not None:
        print(coord, 's=',s, styleinfo(int(s)))
PY
